newsitem.title: UK: British Steel plans five pct buyback at 155p.
newsitem.headline: British Steel plans five pct buyback at 155p.

text.p: British Steel Plc plans to buy back up to five percent of its shares at a price of 155 pence per share, a spokesman for Cazenove & Co, the company appointed to handle the repurchase told Reuters on Thursday.
The steel giant obtained authority for a buyback of up to 10 percent of its share capital at its last annual general meeting under a routine motion.
But it did not give any indication that it would launch a share repurchase programme in its recent annual results statement which saw profits severely hit by sterling's strength.
British Steel's shares were up six pence to 155 1/2 soon after the announcement. The group said the move would enhance the efficiency of its balance sheet and earnings per share.
The group has the authority to buy up to 10 percent of shares, but the Cazenove spokesman said it was looking to buy an initial tranche of 100 million shares or up to five percent for now.
British Steel has net cash of just under 800 million stg.
